verses.text: Since you have given me land in the Negev, give me also springs of water.
verses.title: Give While We Live

verses.text: He has made us competent as ministers of a new covenant—not of the letter but of the Spirit; for the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.
Do your best to present yourself to God as one approved, a worker who does not need to be ashamed and who correctly handles the word of truth.
